text: What a vendor says in public is only as trustworthy as the record that lets someone check it. When that record points at something nobody can retrieve anymore, the claim still reads the same, yet no fresh check can confirm it. In mid-September 2026, ShortsOS found that gap in its own claim records and reproduced it on an untouched copy of its main code line.
